releases.displayName: BALL x PIT: The Naturalist Update is Available Now!

items.text: The final free update for BALL x PIT is here!
The Naturalist Update, available now on all platforms, adds even more characters, Balls, and Passives to the game, greatly expanding the possibilities of a run.
2 NEW CHARACTERS
Players of Ball x Pit: The Naturalist Update will come across two new unlockable characters, each with opposite personalities.
The Ballbearer doubles down on firepower (literally), giving you double the amount of ball slots to build an arsenal at the cost of giving up passive items entirely.

The Hoary Hoarder takes the opposite approach, lugging around an oversized backpack stuffed with gear. They only have room for two ball slots, but make up for it with twice as many passive slots, letting powerful item Evolutions do the heavy lifting.
11 NEW BALLS
Lightning Bug lights up the battlefield by spawning a firefly with every bounce. Each one seeks out the strongest enemy before zapping nearby targets with a burst of lightning.

Mosquito Kingdom slowly builds a buzzing swarm, spawning one or two mosquitoes whenever it hits an enemy. The mosquitoes hunt down the weakest target on the field, dealing between 100-150 damage with each attack, and if one lands the killing blow, well, you simply recover a small amount of health back.
Drill tears through enemies from behind, piercing straight through them and dealing extra damage along the way.
Flesh starts off weak, dealing only half damage, but it rapidly increases in speed with every bounce until it becomes a blur tearing across the screen.

Armageddon calls down a destructive meteor shower the moment it hits an enemy. The first impact marks the target, then flaming meteors rain across the area, dealing heavy damage to every enemy caught within a three-tile radius.
5 NEW PASSIVES
Platinum Dumbbell rewards clean shots, giving your balls a damage boost that lasts until they finally collide with the back wall.
Inglorious Hammer keeps the pressure on after a bounce, causing balls that hit a wall or the back of the arena to immediately strike a random enemy for reduced damage.

Remote Detonator turns every kill into another explosive opportunity. Whenever an enemy goes down, it spawns a level 1 Bomb Ball whenever an enemy dies, keeping the chain reaction going and filling the battlefield with even more booms.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062430/BALL_x_PIT/"]

It’s been a long and wonderful journey since we released the game back in October, and we’re grateful to everyone who shared this adventure with us. We never could have imagined there would be so many ball enthusiasts around the world who share our passion.
But… the adventure isn’t over – keep an eye out for some big, exciting BALL x PIT news coming very soon.
You’re not free from its clutches yet. Sorry.

releases.displayName: BALL x PIT’s free The Shadow Update is available now!

items.text: Think you’re done with balls? THINK AGAIN.
The Shadow Update is available now, free for everyone who owns the game, and brings with it 2 new characters, 11 new balls, and a whole lot more besides.
11 game-changing new balls including some that can bend time, freezing enemies in place or teleporting unpredictably around them.

2 new playable characters: the Tiptoer, a deadly ninja who stays undetected by enemies at close range, and the Tunneller, a miner whose balls don’t stop at the edge of the screen but wrap around it and come back in from the other side.

4 new Passives including the chaotic Full Metal Rapier, which sees each ball scaling its damage based on how many baby balls and enemies are currently on the battlefield, or the Arrow of Fate, which makes you immune to incoming projectiles and fires back a burst of baby balls whenever you’re hit.
A new building to construct in your base: the Guildhall. Build one of these and you can re-roll previously chosen character upgrades.
And don’t think this is the last you’ll hear from us - we’re not done yet. The third free update for BALL x PIT, The Naturalist Update, is coming in July.
Until then, have fun, ball enthusiasts.

releases.displayName: BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update launches April 27

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/904f811f34d895fe63127a23ae27bd8576133a1f.png"]
Hey everyone,
We’re back with more BALL x PIT, as we confirm that our second free update, The Shadow Update, will be released next Monday, April 27!

Time starts to bend in this update, with some new ball evolutions that freeze it and warp it entirely. Expect your runs to get a little more chaotic as we introduce some new balls, passives, and characters alongside the addition of a new building all detailed below!
2 new characters
The Tunneller is a scrappy miner whose shots don’t stop at the edge; they wrap around the screen and come back in from the other side, making just about every angle fair game.
The Tiptoer is a fragile but deadly ninja who stays undetected by enemies at close range at the cost of lower health and damage.
Venom stacks up with each hit, slowing targets and chipping away at them until enough buildup finally locks them in place with paralysis.
Time leans into area control, dropping a timesnare that freezes enemies caught in its range.
Erosion cuts straight through foes, with each hit shaving off a percentage of their current health, making it incredibly nasty against tougher targets.
Time Bomb adds a bit of delayed chaos, planting an explosive that goes off after a short wait.
Timestop does exactly what it sounds like, freezing absolutely everything on the field for a few seconds before going on cooldown.
Warp keeps things unpredictable, blinking to a random spot on the field upon every enemy hit while ramping up speed as it goes.
Sniper shots cut straight through enemies but burn out the moment they hit a wall or loop back, trading longevity for a boosted critical chance that rewards precise enemy line ups.
Heart Swallower gives each hit a certain chance to drain a bit of life and heal you for one while also weakening the target’s attack by a percentage, but remember each enemy can only be drained once.
Plus a few more that we won’t spoil just yet...
4 New Passives
Full Metal Rapier thrives on chaos with each ball scaling its damage based on how many baby balls and enemies are currently on the field.
Arrow of Fate flips defense into offense, making you immune to incoming projectiles and firing back a burst of baby balls whenever you’re hit.
Argent Stopwatch plays with momentum, starting balls off at 150% damage before shaving off 30% with every bounce, so timing and positioning matter more than ever.
Sword Breaker keeps things steady but scalable, lowering base damage to 75% while quietly stacking an extra 1% for every enemy in play.
Better start thinking of a spot to drop the Guildhall! This new building will allow players to re-roll previously chosen character upgrades.

Thank you again to all players supporting and for making BALL x PIT what it is! We hope you’re excited to jump back into the pit when BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update releases for free next week, April 27!
BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update Key Art by Jorge Monlongo

releases.displayName: BALL x PIT: The Regal Update is AVAILABLE NOW!

items.text: BALL x PIT: The Regal Update is NOW AVAILABLE for FREE and it adds a wealth of new content to the game, including new characters, new balls, new passives, and a brand new mode that players have been crying out for since launch.
NEW x CHARACTERS

You can now play as the Falconer, a new character who fires off two balls launched by a pair of birds flanking the screen, giving their attacks a wide, swooping spread. Or take on the role of the Carouser, a medieval royal troublemaker who can twist ball trajectories with a personal gravity field, pulling shots off their usual paths.
NEW x BALLS

A selection of eight powerful new balls includes Fireworks, which burst outward in bright, unpredictable patterns, scattering damage in every direction; the Stone Ball, which hits like a truck on impact but slowly crumbles as it keeps bouncing; and the Landslide, which triggers a cascading wave of debris in front of the first impact point and deals damage that lasts for a few seconds to surrounding enemies.
NEW x PASSIVES

Three new passives have been added to the game - Deadeye’s Impaler cranks up your critical hit chance, and when those crits hit, enemies that are not the boss do not get back up. Well, that’s because they instantly kill. Grotesque Artillery pulls from your own gear, firing off a random ball from your equipped lineup every time it triggers. Iron Onesie rewards chaos, boosting the damage of special balls based on how many baby balls are bouncing around the field.
NEW x MODE

You spoke, and we listened! The long-requested Endless Mode is now available! Each level can now be pushed as far as you can handle, continuing indefinitely as long as you manage to stay alive once finishing the boss in that area and agree to continue deeper into the pit.
HOW TO UNLOCK NEW CONTENT
The new content will unlock as you progress in the game. If you’ve already beaten it, everything should already be unlocked (except for blueprints, which you’ll need to find in levels).
NEW x LANGUAGES
Also, we’re happy to share that the Regal Update is introducing new languages, including: Spanish (Latin America), Polish, Italian, Thai, Turkish, and Ukrainian.
NEW x BUNDLE
Alongside a 20% discount to celebrate The Regal Update release, we also have a vibrant new bundle running with Neon Abyss where players can enjoy an extra 9% off!
As usual, we encourage you to join our Discord for the latest dev updates, support, and community activity.
That's all for now! Have fun, ball enthusiasts! And thank you for your support❤️

releases.displayName: BALL x PIT: The Regal Update Launches January 26th!

items.text: Hello again, ball enthusiasts!
We’ve got some very good news to share today! We’re thrilled to finally be able to share this info, as we know you’ve been growing impatient lately!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/691792af64b5f0111abf0521b66ec85988110a26.png"]
BALL x PIT’s first FREE major update, titled The Regal Update, launches on January 26th - that’s just one week away!
This free update adds a wealth of new content to the game, including new characters, new balls, new passives, and some new features many of you have been crying out for since launch.

notes.title: Meet our two new treasure seekers

items.text: The Carouser, whose returning balls orbit around him.
The Falconer, flanked by her two trusted falcons that throw balls.
Check out the release date short video here
In addition to the new treasure seekers joining the roster, The Regal Update will also introduce 8 new balls and several new passives.

But that’s not all! We’ve got a nice surprise we don’t want to spoil just yet - but we’re sure you’re all going to love it. Stay tuned for Monday, January 26th, when The Regal Update officially launches!
PS: We were just informed that we won “Best NY Game” at the New York Game Awards! 🎉 Woohoo! So blessed to win this prize in our very own city! 💖
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649613/0aaae78ecb91e2a2c089ab50ac5f5678abc798cd.jpg"]
Hi all ball enthusiasts!

We’ve just released the first patch for BALL x PIT! It addresses a good number of the bugs you’ve been reporting since launch. Thank you so much for your support and patience! If you encounter any new bugs or issues, please make sure to report them on the forums or via Discord.
Below, you’ll find the complete patch notes!

Fix bug where cursor would appear stuck on screen with the Physicist
AOE effects now apply lightning rod when combo-ed

Radical and Cogitator can no longer fuse ball with itself

Multiselect tutorial will stop showing up eventually if it is ignored long enough

Structures - The Heavenly Trophy is no longer displayed as fully built while under construction
The amount of gold gathered from multiple Gold Mines now resembles the number shown in the summary screen

The disease status from the Virus no longer passes on friendly tiles

Rearranging from normal base state with controller no longer causes building to start off placed incorrectly
Added option to mute audio in background

releases.displayName: Demo Update Now LIVE with New Content!

items.text: Today is a good day for a DEMO UPDATE!

Since we launched our demo back in June, we’ve been blown away every day by the sheer number of hours you’ve poured into it. We're talking DOZENS of hours per player. We know you’re hungry for more content, and waiting two more weeks for release might feel like an eternity.
So we thought it’d be cool to give you something to munch on until launch.

notes.title: SO HERE YOU GO! A juicy, content-packed update featuring

items.text: Map Expansion: Some extra terrain to build on or grow resources.
New Character - The Cohabitants: An inseparable couple who throw balls in opposite directions, but each ball deals half damage. Twice the chaos!

Twitch Integration Character - The False Messiah: Link your Twitch account in the Options menu to unlock a new character. By playing as 'The False Messiah' when streaming on Twitch, your audience can vote on certain choices and random events — upgrades, fusions, evolutions, and more. They can even bless the streamer with gold!
New Balls: Including the Dark Ball + its evolutions... and even evolutions of evolutions.
New Passives: Cursed Elixir, Voodoo Doll, Pressure Valve, and passive evolutions.
New Buildings: Exorcist and Cozy Home (the Cohabitants' house).
Character Leaderboards.
Balance Changes, QoL Improvements & Bug Fixes.
That should keep all you treasure seekers busy until the full release on October 15! And don’t forget — all demo progress carries over to the final game, so go wild.
We also encourage you to join our Discord server for support, bug reporting, and to hang out with fellow ball enthusiasts sharing tips and strategies. We’re all ballin’ in there.
That’s all for now! We hope you enjoy the new content, and thank you for your support! ❤️
